What is the RK3576?

RK3576 is a low-power quad-core SoC [CITE-1] built for edge AI workloads. It pairs a Mali-G52 GPU with a 6 TOPS NPU [CITE-2] and targets always-on inference.

Key features

  • Quad-core Cortex-A72 [CITE-1]
  • 6 TOPS NPU for INT4/INT8 models [CITE-1]
  • HardsWare codecs for 4K decode [CITE-2]
  • bad

Use cases

Common use is industrial gateways, Kiosks and small NAS services.
